extracted.name: Healthy Caesar Dressing
extracted.description: Made with Greek yogurt instead of mayo, this healthy Caesar salad dressing is higher in protein and less rich than most. Still, it's creamy, tangy, and delicious. Try it on a Caesar salad, on a wrap, or as a dip.
ingredient_lines: ⅓ cup whole milk Greek yogurt
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, capers, and several grinds of black pepper. Season to taste.
